scope: label-free nonlinear gates over the five direction-stable dense-Prithvi residuals on folds 3 and 4
feature_rule: only unique univariate candidates whose fold, sensor, recall, and paired-site gates all passed

base_residual.normalization: unlabeled empirical-rank inverse-normal transform within each fold x sensor
base_residual.orientation: positive direction learned only from the opposite fold
base_residual.base_score: exact float64 current scene score in logit space

transform_definitions.symmetric: the original oriented invariant residual without further scaling
transform_definitions.uncertainty_weighted: multiply by 4*p*(1-p), concentrating changes near uncertain current scores
transform_definitions.low_score_weighted: multiply by 1-p, emphasizing recovery among lower current scores
transform_definitions.high_score_weighted: multiply by p, emphasizing refinement among higher current scores
transform_definitions.winsorized: clip the residual symmetrically to the frozen winsor limit

transform_parameters.post_transform_normalization: all transforms except symmetric are unlabeled mean-zero/unit-variance standardized within each fold x sensor

target_domain.name: low-prevalence physical-location proxy for the official test-only-site view
target_domain.membership: all rows from physical_location_id groups whose combined folds-3/4 positive rate is <=0.05
target_domain.use: evaluation and gating only; no site prevalence or labels enter a transform

invariants: Every represented sample comes from a dense adapter that excluded that sample's fold.
Every selected feature previously passed both fold directions, both sensors, recall, and paired-site gates.
Feature orientation is learned only from the opposite fold.
Every transform uses only the invariant residual and the exact current score.
Post-transform centering and scaling are unlabeled and confined to each fold x sensor.
The low-prevalence definition affects evaluation only.
Only point-gate survivors can consume paired-site bootstrap computation.
Both whole-development and low-prevalence paired-site AP lower bounds must be strictly positive.
A development pass can only authorize a separately frozen fold-2 confirmation.
Fold 2, fresh data, and exact-paper inputs are never loaded.
